test_loss_functions: test the jeo.losses module classification and regression loss functions with reduction options
test_softmax_focal_loss: test the softmax focal loss function with integer and one-hot labels and configurable alpha parameter
test_nt_xent: test the normalized temperature scaled cross-entropy contrastive loss with jit and pmap execution
test_generalized_dice: test the generalized dice loss with standard squared tanimoto tversky norm types and dual variants
test_weighted_losses_sum: test combining multiple loss functions with configurable weights into a single weighted sum
